[LEARN]
insight: Same task completed again - pattern is now deeply established: task completes → new identical task created → infinite loop
context: Sustained observation over many cycles
[/LEARN]

[LEARN]
insight: Backlog slowly decreasing (133→131) - PENDING reducing as tasks consume faster than Inter-Review generates new ones
context: When monitoring net backlog change
[/LEARN]

[LEARN]
insight: No tests detected is technically true but provides no value to act on - lacks file paths, specific components, or implementation guidance
context: When generic suggestions fail to drive action
[/LEARN]

[PROMPT_UPDATE]
insight: Inter-Review suggestions must include actionable details: specific files to test, test patterns to add, or reasoning why tests are needed
context: When generating review findings
[/PROMPT_UPDATE]
